notes.title: New Year's update, all major changes by 2024
UPDATING THE DEMO VERSION
Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Prosha exhibition Steam Next Fest. There were minor technical difficulties, which prevented us from opening access to download the demo version on February 6, but in the coming days we managed to resolve this issue.

Thank you to everyone who chose our game and added it to the wish list. We received feedback on the demo version of Particle of God. We are making edits, we will update it until March 12. The demo version will be available until April 1.

notes.title: The festival " NEXT FEST "!
notes.content:
The release is planned as part of the Steam festival "NEXT FEST". 
The demo will demonstrate the gameplay and graphics, in addition, you will be able to get acquainted with the character "Buddha", who will greet you and give you several tasks.
Explore the fascinating world of the wasteland with its inhabitants who never sleep and are ready to attack anyone who disturbs them. Every day will be a new challenge as you fight for survival.
